spans.s: चक् vi. 1Ā (pp. चकित; pres. चकते) 1. To be satiated, to be satisfied; 2. to repel, to resist.

चकास् vi. 2U (pp. चकासित; pres. चकास्ति-स्ते) 1. To shine, to be bright, चकासतं चारुचमूरुचर्मणा Sis.i.8, iii.6, Bt.iii.37; 2. to be prosperous, वितन्वति क्षेममदेवमातृकाश्चिराय तस्मिन्कुरवश्चकासते Kir.i.17.With वि-, to shine, to be bright.

चकित a. (f. ता) 1. Trembling or shaking through fear, Megh.i.27; 2. fearful, timid पौलस्त्यचकितेश्वराः (दिशः) R.x.73; 3. startled, frightened, व्याधानुसारचकिता हरिणीव यासि Mrich.i.(चकितम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘alarmingly,’ ‘with fear,’ ‘in a frightened manner,’ सभयचकितं विन्यस्यंतीं दृशौ तिमिरे पथि Git.G.v.)

चकित a. (f. ता) 1. Trembling or shaking through fear, Megh.i.27; 2. fearful, timid पौलस्त्यचकितेश्वराः (दिशः) R.x.73; 3. startled, frightened, व्याधानुसारचकिता हरिणीव यासि Mrich.i.(चकितम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘alarmingly,’ ‘with fear,’ ‘in a frightened manner,’ सभयचकितं विन्यस्यंतीं दृशौ तिमिरे पथि Git.G.v.)
चकोर m. A kind of bird, the Greek partridge, श्रीमुखचंद्रचकोर Git.G.ix., स्फुरदधरसीधवे तव वदनचंद्रमा रोचयति लोचनचकोरम् x., R.vi.59, vii.25.

चक्र (I) n. 1. The wheel of a carriage, Yaj.i.351; 2. a potter’s wheel; 3. a sharp circular missile weapon, a disc (especially applied to the disc of Viṣṇu); 4. an oil-mill; 5. a circle, a ring, कलापचक्रेषु निवेशिताननम् Bt.i.16; 6. a form of military array in a circle; 7. a circle or depression of the body; 8. a cycle, a cycle of years; 9. the horizon; 10. a troop, a multitude; 11. an army, a host; 12. a group of villages, a province, a district; 13. section of a book; 14. realm, sovereignty; 15. a whirlpool.
चक्र (II) m. 1. The ruddy goose (also called चक्रवाक); 2. a multitude, a troop.
चाक्र (f. क्री) 1. Carried on with the discus (as a battle); 2. circular; 3. relating to a wheel.
चक्राकी f. a goose (f).
चक्राकी f. a goose (f).
चक्र-अंग m. 1. a gander having a curved neck; 2. a car; 3. the ruddy goose (चक्रवाक).
चक्र-अट m. 1. a juggler, a snake-catcher; 2. a knave, a cheat; 3. a particular coin, a dīnāra.
चक्र-आकार, -आकृति a. circular, round.
चक्र-आकार, -आकृति a. circular, round.
चक्र-आयुध m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
चक्र-आवर्त m. a rotatory motion.
चक्र-आह्व, -आह्वय m. the ruddy goose, चक्राह्वं ग्रामकुक्कुटम् M.v.12.
चक्र-आह्व, -आह्वय m. the ruddy goose, चक्राह्वं ग्रामकुक्कुटम् M.v.12.
चक्र-ईश्वर m. the officer in charge of a district.
चक्र-उपजीविन् m. an oilman.
चक्र-कारक n. 1. a nail; 2. a kind of perfume.
चक्र-गंडु m. a round pillow.
चक्र-गति f. rotation, revolution.
चक्र-गुच्छ m. the aśoka tree.
चक्र-ग्रहण n. a rampart, an entrenchment.
चक्र-ग्रहणी f. a rampart, an entrenchment.
चक्र-चर a. moving in a flight.
चक्र-चूडामणि m. a round jewel in a crownet or diadem.
चक्र-जीवक, -जीविन् m. a potter.
चक्र-जीवक, -जीविन् m. a potter.
चक्र-तीर्थ n. name of a holy place.
चक्र-दंष्ट्र m. a hog.
चक्र-धर m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu, चक्रधरप्रभावः R.xvi.55; 2. a sovereign, a governor of a province; 3. a village tumbler or juggler.
चक्र-धारा f. periphery of a wheel.
चक्र-नाभि f. the nave of a wheel.
चक्र-नामन् m. 1. a pyritic ore of iron; 2. the ruddy goose.
चक्र-नायक m. 1. the leader of a troop; 2. a kind of perfume.
चक्र-नेमि f. the circumference of a wheel, नीचैर्गच्छत्युपरि च दशा चक्रनेमिक्रमेण Megh.ii.46.
चक्र-पाणि m. an epithet of Viṣṇu, e.g. प्रायेन निष्क्रामति चक्रपाणैः.
चक्र-पाद, -पादक m. 1. a carriage; 2. an elephant.
चक्र-पाद, -पादक m. 1. a carriage; 2. an elephant.
चक्र-पाल m. 1. the superintendent or governor of a province; 2. an officer commanding a division of an army.
चक्र-बंधु, -बांधव m. the sun.
चक्र-बंधु, -बांधव m. the sun.
चक्र-वाड, -वाल (I) m. 1. a ring, a circle; 2. the horizon; 3. a mass, a multitude.
चक्र-वाड, -वाल (I) m. 1. a ring, a circle; 2. the horizon; 3. a mass, a multitude.
चक्र-वाल (II) m. 1. a mythical range of mountain supposed to encircle the orb of the earth like a wall and to be the limit of light and darkness; 2. the ruddy goose (चक्रवाक).
चक्र-भृत् m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. one who holds a disc.
चक्र-भेदिनी f. the night.
चक्र-भ्रम m. a turner’s lathe, आरोप्य चक्रभ्रमिमुष्णतेजास्त्वष्ट्रेव यत्नोल्लिखितो विभाति R.vi.32.
चक्र-भ्रमि f. a turner’s lathe, आरोप्य चक्रभ्रमिमुष्णतेजास्त्वष्ट्रेव यत्नोल्लिखितो विभाति R.vi.32.
चक्र-मंडलिन् m. a species of cobra.
चक्र-मुख m. a hog.
चक्र-यान n. a wheel-carriage.
चक्र-रद m. a hog.
चक्र-वत् m. 1. an oilman; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. a sovereign, an emperor.
चक्र-वर्तिन् (I) m. an emperor, a sovereign, an absolute ruler whose dominion extends as far as the ocean, पुत्रमेवंगुणोपेतं चक्रवर्तिनमाप्नुहि Sak.i.
चक्र-वर्तिन् (II) a. like the ruddy goose in shape, तव तनि कुचावेतौ नियतं चक्रवर्तिनौ । आसमुद्रक्षितीशोऽपि भवान् यत्र करप्रदः Ud. (where the word is used in both the senses).
चक्र-वाक m. (fem. ˚की) the ruddy goose, दूरीभूते मयि सहचरे चक्रवाकीमिवैकाम् Megh.ii.20, Bhartr.i.81.
चक्र-वाट m. 1. a limit, a boundary; 2. a lamp-stand; 3. engaging in an action.
चक्र-वात m. a whirlwind, a hurricane.
चक्र-वृद्धि f. interest upon interest, compound interest, M.viii.153, 156.
चक्र-व्यूह m. a circular array of troops.
चक्र-संज्ञ (I) n. tin.
चक्र-संज्ञ (II) m. the ruddy goose.
चक्र-साह्वय m. the ruddy goose.
चक्र-हस्त m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
चक्रक (I) a. (f. का) Wheel-shaped, circular.
चक्रक (II) m. Arguing in a circle (in Logic).
चक्रक (I) a. (f. का) Wheel-shaped, circular.
चक्रिका f. 1. A heap, a troop; 2. a fraudulent device; 3. the knee.
चाक्रिक (I) a. (f. की) The same as चाक्र q.v.
चाक्रिक (II) m. 1. A potter; 2. an oilmaker, Yaj.i.165 (where Vijnyāneśvara renders चाक्रिक by तैलिक and adds शाकटिकश्चेत्येके); 3. a proclaimer; 4. a chorister; 5. a coachman, a driver.
चक्रिन् m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. a potter; 3. an oilman; 4. an emperor, a sovereign, an absolute monarch; 5. the ruddy goose; 6. a snake; 7. a crow; 8. an ass; 9. a kind of juggler.
चक्रिय a. (f. या) Going in a carriage, being on a journey.
चक्रिय a. (f. या) Going in a carriage, being on a journey.
चक्रीवत् m. An ass.

चक्ष् vt. 2Ā (pres. चष्टे; this root is defective in non-conjugational tenses) 1. To see, to perceive; 2. to spenk, to tell, to say, (with the dat. of the person addressed.)With आ-, 1. to declare, to teach, M.iv.81; 2. to speak, to relate, to narrate, इत्याख्यानविद आचक्षते M.M.ii.; 3. to call.With परि-, 1. to declare, to relate; 2. to call, वेदप्रदानादाचार्यं पितरं परिचक्षते M.ii.71, Bg.xvii.13, 17.With प्र-, 1. to say, to speak, दहति प्रेतमिति प्रचक्षते R.viii.86; 2. to call, तं देवनिर्मितं देशं ब्रह्मावर्तं प्रचक्षते M.ii.17.With प्रत्या-, to repulse.With व्या-, to explain.
चक्षस् m. 1. A teacher, an instructor in sacred sciences; 2. an epithet of Bṛhaspati.
चक्षुष्य a. (f. ष्या) 1. Good-looking, agreeable to the eyes, beautiful; 2. beneficial to the eyes.
चक्षुष्य a. (f. ष्या) 1. Good-looking, agreeable to the eyes, beautiful; 2. beneficial to the eyes.
चक्षुष्या f. A pleasing or agreeable woman.
चक्षुस् n. 1. The eye, निवातपद्मस्तिमितेन चक्षुसा R.iii.17, i.55, M.ii.8; 2. the faculty of seeing, sight, look, M.iv.41, 42.
चक्षुस्-पथ m. the horizon, the range of sight.
चक्षुस्-श्रवस् m. a snake, Na.i.28.
चक्षुर्गोचर a. coming within the range of the eye.
चक्षुर्दान f. the ceremony of anointing the eyes of an image at the time of consecration.
चक्षुर्मल n. the excretion of the eyes.
चक्षुर्विषय m. 1. visibility, presence, M.ii.198; 2. an object of sight, any visible object.
चक्षूराग m. 1. redness in eye; 2. lore or liking as expressed by exchange of glances, चक्षूरागः कोकिलेषु न परकलत्रेषु Kad. (where the word is used in both the senses).
चक्षूरोग m. a disease of the eye.
चक्षुष्मत् a. 1. having clear sight or good eyes; 2. endowed with the faculty of seeing, R.iv.18.
चाकचक्य n. Brilliancy.
चाक्र (f. क्री) 1. Carried on with the discus (as a battle); 2. circular; 3. relating to a wheel.
चाक्रिक (I) a. (f. की) The same as चाक्र q.v.
चाक्रिण m. The son of a potter or oilmaker.
चाक्षुष (I) a. (f. षी) 1. Depending on or produced by sight; 2. belonging to the eye, optical; 3. visible, seen.
चाक्षुष (II) n. Knowledge dependent on vision.
चाक्षुष (I) a. (f. षी) 1. Depending on or produced by sight; 2. belonging to the eye, optical; 3. visible, seen.
चाक्षुष-ज्ञान n. ocular evidence.
